recipes.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay 3 life.
Counter target creature spell.

recipe_coverage: Whole Oracle text and source characteristics are pinned against the reviewed counter extension profile. Real casting/response windows cover both source controllers, own and opposing spells, full costs, insufficient mana, no stack, legal target relationships, exact zone receipts, populated-zone snapshots and printed immediate secondary effects.  Printed additional life cost and insufficient-life legality are checked separately. Countered source spells, pending-target departure, protection/prevention interactions, replacement effects, other stack objects, control changes and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
